Personal photos of the family's 2x2 cube, used by `tests/colorread.test.js` and `tests/e2e/camera.py`.
They are ignored by git. To use them, copy the photos here as `side1.jpg` to `side4.jpg`
(front, right, back, left, each taken with the cube's top at the top of the photo).
Expected colors (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right):
side1 WGYO, side2 WBYG, side3 WBRB, side4 ORYG.
